title: Procurement of a waste gas wet scrubber for the WBG Pilot Line project
description: Procurement of a waste gas wet scrubber for the WBG Pilot Line project Tampere University Foundation sr (hereinafter the "Contracting Authority" or "Client") invites tenders for the supply of the waste gas wet scrubber as an equipment supply for the WBG Pilot Line project (also referred to as "SiPFAB" in the procurement documents), including all necessary hardware and materials. The scope covers procurement, installation, and commissioning, bringing the equipment to a fully operational state in accordance with the project plans. The project involves the construction of new research and production facilities for the SiPFAB research project. The ISO 5 and ISO 7 cleanrooms, together with the related office and auxiliary spaces, form part of the main contract. The main contract commenced in May 2026 and is scheduled for acceptance on 1 April 2027. The works under this separate contract are scheduled to commence after the completion and acceptance of the main contract, with the estimated implementation period being April–June 2027. During the execution of this separate contract, the Contracting Entity will appoint a separate Main Contractor responsible for site management. The Main Contractor will be selected at a later stage. The Wide Band Gap (WBG) Pilot Line is part of the European Union’s Chips Act initiative. Under the Chips Act, five pilot lines have been established to cover different areas of semiconductor technology. The WBG Pilot Line focuses on power electronics and high-frequency radio-frequency technologies based on novel wide band gap materials. The Pilot Line develops the manufacturing of these materials, as well as chips and components based on them, enabling products with higher performance and efficiency than those based on conventional silicon technology. Tampere University is responsible for all chip packaging activities within the Pilot Line through its new WBG Pilot Line cleanroom facility. The WBG Pilot Line is funded by Chips JU and Business Finland. The procurement of the gas scrubber is identified within the WBG Pilot Line project by the equipment code TAU.WP9.58. SiPFAB (System-in-Package Fabrication) is a pilot line being established at Tampere University’s Hervanta campus, focusing on semiconductor chip packaging, integration and testing. The infrastructure supports the processing, packaging, integration and testing of Wide Band Gap (WBG) semiconductor devices, as well as other semiconductor components. SiPFAB provides an environment for piloting industrial advanced semiconductor packaging technologies. The wet scrubber to be procured will be used for the treatment of exhaust air generated by semiconductor processing activities within the SiPFAB facility. The primary application of the wet scrubber is the treatment and abatement of emissions generated during various semiconductor wet processes, such as ammonia etching and acid cleaning using piranha and aqua regia solutions. The purpose of the wet scrubber is to remove or reduce chemical contaminants contained in the process exhaust air to the levels specified in the procurement documents, thereby enabling the safe and controlled operation of the SiPFAB processes. The equipment will be integrated into the SIPFAB building services systems and shall be suitable for the specified process conditions, chemicals, airflow rates and operating loads. The equipment must be capable of handling a maximum airflow of 5,000 m³/h. The site address is Korkeakoulunkatu 8, 33720 Tampere. This procurement is executed as a separate acquisition by the end-user, encompassing the procurement of equipment, on-site transport (rigging), installation based on the Client’s plans, and final commissioning and testing to ensure full operational readiness. The scope also includes providing operational training and user manuals to the Client, as well as verifying the purity level of the compressed air supply. The Supplier shall work under the direction of the Main Contractor and shall comply with the site safety regulations and fulfil its occupational health and safety obligations. The selected Supplier shall agree on the detailed site practices with the Main Contractor. The delivery shall include a warranty period of at least two (2) years. The warranty shall be subject to the terms and conditions specified in Section 15 of the Appendix “Commercial and Implementation Terms for Equipment Supply”. After the warranty period, the selected Supplier shall be obliged to provide spare parts for the equipment, for a separately agreed fee, for at least ten (10) years from the completion of the deliver The subject matter of the procurement is described in more detail in the appendices to the Invitation to Tender.,

title: Stripping test equipment
description: Stripping test equipment South-Eastern Finland University of Applied Sciences (Xamk) is purchasing a Stripping test equipment as part of the “Xamk - LUKE NOHEVA Forest Bioeconomy RI" project funded by the Academy of Finland during 1.1.2026 – 30.12.2028. Procurement background and objectives The procurement is part of the “Xamk - LUKE NOHEVA Forest Bioeconomy RI” project, which aims to strengthen Xamk’s forest bioeconomy research environment in Savonlinna Finland. Stripping is a common method for removing volatile compounds from liquids. Xamk is expanding its pilot-scale research and testing capabilities. As part of this development, Xamk is investing in stripping test equipment that enables the testing and optimization of gas stripping processes and the removal of volatile compounds from liquid streams. The equipment will significantly complement and strengthen the research environment’s capabilities and collaboration opportunities with both academic and industrial partners. The purchased equipment will be located at the FiberLaboratory, which is a multidisciplinary research and testing environment operated by Xamk. The laboratory is an innovative, networked operating environment for developing future bioproduct processes, implementing new ideas, solving process technology problems and testing industrial maintenance. FiberLaboratory promotes the sustainable development of the forest and technology industry as well as the sensible use of resources. Functional requirements and reference process concept A reference Process Flow Diagram (PFD) is provided in Appendix 1 for illustrative purposes. The procurement concerns pilot-scale research and test equipment for stripping experiments. The equipment includes two stripping columns and the necessary systems for liquid preparation and feeding, heating, stripping gas supply, vapour handling, cooling, measurement and process control. Alternative technical solutions may be accepted, provided they meet all required operational capabilities and minimum requirements of the invitation to tender.,

description: Die RheinEnergie AG betreibt im Auftrag der „Bergische Licht-, Kraft- und Wasserwerke GmbH“ (kurz: BELKAW) das Wasserwerk Refrath (WW-RR). Die BELKAW GmbH ist das regionale Unternehmen für Strom, Gas, Wärme und Wasser der Stadt Bergisch Gladbach. Das bestehende Wasserwerk Refrath ist westlich des gleichnamigen Stadtteils Refrath gelegen. Refrath gehört zur Stadt Bergisch Gladbach im Bergischen Land in Nordrhein-Westfalen. title: EGNZW - LSA BGES214 - Marler Str. / Egonstr. / Valentinstr.
description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist der Ersatzneubau einer Lichtsignalanlage (LSA) am vierarmigen Knotenpunkt „Marler Straße – Egonstraße – Valentinstraße“ im Stadtgebiet Gelsenkirchen im Rahmen des Projektes „Erschließung der ehemaligen Schachtanlage Westerholt für Nachfolgenutzungen“. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst die vollständige Lieferung, Montage und betriebsfertige Inbetriebnahme der Lichtsignalanlage im Auftrag der Entwicklungsgesellschaft Neue Zeche Westerholt. Darüber hinaus sind die Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsleistungen für die errichtete Anlage über einen Zeitraum von 48 Monaten im Auftrag der Stadt Gelsenkirchen zu erbringen. Die zur Herstellung der LSA erforderlichen Tiefbauleistungen sind nicht Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung und werden separat vergeben. Diese Ausschreibung ist Teil eines Förderprojektes der Entwicklung der „Neuen Zeche Westerholt“.

title: MALDI-TOF mass-spektromeeter Terviseametile
description: Riigihanke eesmärk on soetada Terviseamet laborile uus MALDI-TOF mass-spektromeeter koos tööks vajalike lisaseadmete, tarkvara, andmebaaside, tarvikute ja tootja poolt ettenähtud kontrollmaterjalidega. Hanke esemeks on seadme tarnimine, paigaldamine (Paldiski mnt 81, Tallinn) ja kasutuselevõtt, labori infosüsteemiga liidestamine, kasutajate koolitamine ning seadme täishooldusteenuse osutamine 24 kuu jooksul alates seadme üleandmisest. Seade peab võimaldama mikroorganismide kiiret ja usaldusväärset identifitseerimist vähemalt liigi tasemel ning vastama hankedokumentides sätestatud tehnilistele nõuetele. Pakkuja peab seadme tarnima, paigaldama, seadistama ja andma seadme hankijale töökorras ning täielikult kasutusvalmina üle hiljemalt 60 kalendripäeva jooksul hankelepingu sõlmimisest arvates. / Kõrvaldamise alused ja kvalifitseerimistingimused: Vaata hanke alusdokumentidest

title: Miljøtjenester for Oppdal kommune
description: Oppdal kommune har behov for levering av miljøtjenester. Med miljøtjenester menes målrettet miljøarbeid rettet mot personer med funksjonsnedsettelser, utviklingsforstyrrelser samt innbyggere innen rus- og psykisk helse-feltet. Målrettet miljøarbeid innebærer å tilrettelegge for at den enkelte, i størst mulig grad, kan leve et selvstendig liv, mestre egen hverdag og oppnå en meningsfull tilværelse i tråd med egne forutsetninger og behov. Oppdragsgiver har til hensikt å inngå parallelle rammeavtaler med inntil fire leverandører. Leverandørene som tildeles rammeavtale vil, ved behov, bli invitert til å delta i minikonkurranser om konkrete oppdrag innenfor rammeavtalens omfang og vilkår. Avtalens varighet er to (2) år fra kontraktsinngåelse, med opsjon for oppdragsgiver til å forlenge avtalen med ett (1) år av gangen, totalt inntil to (2) år. Maksimal samlet avtaleperiode er dermed fire (4) år. Forventet oppstart er 01.02.2026. Oppdragsgiver har som mål å styrke kommunens egen kompetanse innen målrettet miljøarbeid og på sikt kunne ivareta flere tjenester i egen regi. Leverandøren skal derfor bidra til kompetanseoverføring gjennom samarbeid, veiledning og deling av relevant fagkompetanse når oppdragsgiver ber om dette. Omfanget av slik kompetanseoverføring vil avtales nærmere i forbindelse med det enkelte avrop. Estimert verdi av rammeavtalen er om lag 50 millioner kroner eksklusive merverdiavgift for hele avtaleperioden, inkludert opsjoner. Avtalens maksimale verdi er 55 millioner kroner eksklusive merverdiavgift. Dette er en Anskaffelse etter del I og IV.

title: Sanierung Laerholz 17/19 Elektro
description: BESCHREIBUNG DES BAUVORHABENS Das Akademische Förderungswerk AöR Bochum beabsichtigt die umfassende energetische Sanierung und Modernisierung des Studierendenwohnheims Laerholz 17 und 19 in Bochum-Querenburg. Ziel der Maßnahme ist die nachhaltige Verbesserung der energetischen Qualität des Gebäudebestandes, die Reduzierung des Primärenergiebedarfs, die Erhöhung des Wohnkomforts für die Studierenden sowie die langfristige Sicherstellung eines wirtschaftlichen und zukunftsfähigen Betriebs. Die Wohnanlage befindet sich unmittelbar im Hochschulbereich der Ruhr-Universität Bochum und ist Bestandteil des Wohnheimstandortes Laerholz 17+19. Die Gebäude dienen ausschließlich der studentischen Wohnnutzung und umfassen Einzelappartements mit zugeordneten Gemeinschafts- und Technikflächen. Die Bestandsgebäude wurden in den 1970er-Jahren errichtet und entsprechen in wesentlichen Bereichen nicht mehr den heutigen Anforderungen an Energieeffizienz, Nachhaltigkeit, Klimaschutz, Brandschutz und Nutzerkomfort. Im Rahmen der Gesamtmaßnahme erfolgt daher eine umfassende Erneuerung der Gebäudehülle einschließlich Fassaden, Fenster, Dachflächen sowie ausgewählter haustechnischer Anlagen. Die Bewohnerzimmer werden entkernt und vollständig modernisiert. Wandoberflächen werden gespachtelt und gestrichen. Der Boden der Zimmer wird mit einer PVC- Fliese belegt. Bäder und Einbauküchen werden erneuert. Flurzonen erhalten die gleiche PVC-Fliese wie die Bewohnerzimmer. Die Treppenstufen im Haupttreppenhaus bleiben wie im Bestand mit Betonwerkstein belegt. Die öffentlichen Verkehrsflächen und Gemeinschaftsräume im Unter- und Erdgeschoss jenseits der Wohnflure werden mit Fliesen belegt. In den Flurbereichen des Wohnheims werden sämtliche Oberflächen schadstoffsaniert, sowie gespachtelt und überarbeitet.

title: Servicekräfte Wannenrückführung an der zentralen Fluggastkontrolle, Terminal 1 – Flughafen Köln/Bonn
description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Erbringung von Dienstleistungen zur Wannenrückführung und Passagierunterstützung an der zentralen Fluggastkontrollstelle im Terminal 1 des Flughafens Köln/Bonn. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst insbesondere die Sichtkontrolle benutzter Kontrollwannen auf zurückgelassene Gegenstände, die Rückführung leerer Wannen in das Fördersystem, die Sicherstellung eines kontinuierlichen Wannennachschubs sowie die Unterstützung und Anleitung von Fluggästen bei der Wannenverwendung. Darüber hinaus gehören die Unterstützung eines geordneten Passagierflusses, die Übergabe aufgefundener Gegenstände und das Aussortieren defekter oder stark verschmutzter Wannen zu den Aufgaben. Die Dienstleistungen sind ganzjährig an 365 Tagen, 24 Stunden täglich und sieben Tage pro Woche sicherzustellen. Die konkreten Einsatzzeiten und der Personalbedarf werden zwischen Auftraggeber und Auftragnehmer abgestimmt. Die eigenverantwortliche Personal- und Einsatzplanung obliegt dem Auftragnehmer. Die Leistungserbringung erfolgt im Sicherheitsbereich des Flughafens. Das eingesetzte Personal muss die erforderlichen Sicherheitsüberprüfungen, Schulungen und Zugangsberechtigungen besitzen. Sicherheitsrelevante Kontrollhandlungen an Personen oder Gepäck sind nicht Bestandteil des Auftrags.

In accordance with the attachments in this solicitation, the submitted proposal must be accompanied by all supporting data and facts used to develop the proposal that are accurate, current, and complete to allow Government evaluators to make their independent assessments. Written rationale is requested to define calculations and assumptions made when preparing the proposal. Please provide actuals and any other information that supports the proposed cost elements for each task, Basis of Estimate (BOE). The proposal should include all labor hours and rates proposed by labor category, as well as material, subcontractors, overhead and other direct costs that the Contractor expects to incur in this effort. A proposal received without sufficient supporting data and rationale, such as inadequate cost/pricing data, will delay the procurement award and/or will result in the proposal being rejected by the Procuring Contract Officer. The Contractor and any subcontractors must provide certified cost and pricing data in accordance with FAR 15.403-4 that meet or exceed the $10,000,000 threshold. In accordance with FAR 15.406-2, a Certificate of Current Cost or Pricing Data is required from the Contractor any subcontractors, certifying that the cost or pricing data submitted in support of the proposal are current, accurate, and complete. The Contractor shall complete and provide the checklist in accordance with DFARs 252.215-7009 identifying whether each of the criteria are met and provide a copy with the submission of the proposal. For major subcontracts over $10,000,000, please include a completed cost and pricing analysis in accordance with FAR 15.404-3(b). In the event that the Contractor or any of its subcontractors have non-complying existing deficiencies, the Government requests that these deficiencies be reported to the PCO as soon as they are known. **Instructions for submitting the DD2345 and details applicable to the evaluation criteria are included in the Buy Terms attached in this solicitation.** **Please submit all proposals no later than 23 November 2026 at 9 AM to Molly Jackson (molly.s.jackson.civ@us.navy.mil).*

title: Bid-Build (BB) Replace Miami VAHCS BLDG1 Roof
description: Solicitation Description 36C24826R0132 Replace Miami VAMC Building 1 Roof, Project No. 546-24-129 The Department of Veterans Affairs, Network Contracting Office 8 (NCO 8), is issuing this Request for Proposal (RFP) under FAR Part 15 to replace the roofing system on Building 1 at the Bruce W. Carter VA Medical Center, 1201 NW 16th Street, Miami, FL 33125. Scope of work: The contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, materials, equipment, and services needed to remove and replace about 214,637 square feet of roofing on Building 1. Work shall follow the drawings, specifications, and Statement of Work. The project includes: phased construction demolition of the existing roofing system installation of the new roofing system removal and reinstallation of the photovoltaic panels replacement of the Lightning Protection System manufacturer inspections and certifications all related work needed to keep disruption to hospital operations to a minimum NAICS Code: 238160, Roofing Contractors Small Business Size Standard: $19.0 million Magnitude of Construction: Between $10,000,000 and $20,000,000, per VAAR 836.204 Period of Performance: 1,095 calendar days after receipt of the Notice to Proceed Set-Aside: This procurement is set aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSBs) under 38 U.S.C. § 8127, using a tiered set-aside evaluation under VAAR 819.7010. SDVOSB offers will be evaluated first, then VOSB offers, then other small business offers, then large business offers. A lower tier will be evaluated only if no award can be made at a higher tier. Basis for Award: Best value to the Government. All non-price factors combined are significantly more important than price. Important Dates: Site Visit: Friday, December 4, 2026, at 9:00 AM EST Requests for Information (RFIs) Due: Wednesday, December 9, 2026, at 11:00 AM EST Proposals Due: Monday, December 28, 2026, at 11:00 AM EST Registration: When proposals are submitted and at award, offerors must be actively registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at https://www.sam.gov. Offerors submitting as SDVOSBs or VOSBs must also be certified by the U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) and listed in SBA's Small Business Search (SBS) at https://search.certifications.sba.gov/ at the time of proposal submission and at the time of award. A joint venture may be considered eligible as an SDVOSB/VOSB if it complies with 13 CFR 128.402. Availability of Funds: Funds are not currently available for this procurement. No award will be made until appropriated funds become available (FAR 52.232-18).

Mechanical cleaning methods shall be applied just prior to the actual start of welding, to remove any reoxidation or residual thin oxide films. 3.10.1 CHEMICAL TREATMENT. An acid deoxidizing treatment shall be applied by either immersion or brushing/wiping. Deoxidizers acceptable for use shall include nitric acid, sulfuric chromic, phosphoric chromic, or equivalent solutions. Sodium hydroxide solutions shall not be used. Care shall be taken to assure 100% solution coverage of the area to be welded. To allow an adequately sized deoxidized area for good welding, the solution shall be applied to an area extending at least 2 inches from the weld site, or ending at any closer adjacent edge. 3.10.2 MEC

title: UHP Water Jet Blasting Services
description: The U.S. Coast Guard Yard, Baltimore, MD, has a requirement for Ultra High Pressure (UHP) Water Jet Blasting Services and supplementary vacuum-assisted mechanical/hand tooling services. Performance is required on various vessels that are scheduled for Yard Availabilities, both dry-docked and pier-side. The vessel lengths vary and include 327� Eagle, 270' Medium Endurance Cutters, 225' Seagoing Buoy Tenders, 210' Medium Endurance Cutters, 175' Coastal Buoy Tender, 154� Sentinel-Class, 140' Ice Breakers, 110' and 87' Patrol Boats, 75� and 65' Tender/Barge configurations, as well as Foreign Military Sales and Other Government Agency (OGA) vessels. UHP water jet blasting will be used to remove coatings and contaminants from designated U.S. Coast Guard vessel surfaces to achieve the WJ-2/L surface preparation standard on targeted vessel surfaces. Offerors must be experienced with UHP water jet blasting surfaces to National Association of Corrosion Engineers International (NACE)/The Society for Protective Coatings (SSPC) Surface Preparation Standard WJ-2/L. Offerors must maintain an active Society for Protective Coatings (SSPC) QP1 certification and must provide, at a minimum, one SSPC-C13 certified person on-site for managing personnel while performing these services. Performance shall take place at the U.S. Coast Guard Yard located at 2401 Hawkins Point Road, Baltimore, MD 21226. The Government intends to make multiple awards as a result of this solicitation. Each contract shall consist of one (1) 12-month base period with four (4) 12-month options periods, if exercised. This requirement is being solicited as a total small business set-aside. The NAICS is 336611 with a size standard of 1,250 employees. Prices shall be F.O.B. Destination. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which shall be considered by the Agency. Questions regarding this solicitation must be submitted in writing no later than 12/18/2026. Quotations submitted after the established deadline shall not be considered.

description: An Unrestricted solicitation will be issued to establish an Indefinite Quantity Contract (IQC) for NSN 2945-01-616-9728, a FILTER ELEMENT, FLUID. The award will be for a 5-year base period. The Estimated Annual Quantity (EAQ) is 1280 EACH. Production units will be FOB: Destination; Inspection /Acceptance: Origin. Item is critical but not deemed a Critical Safety Item. Surge applies, MWR = 7 each. The proposed contract action is for supplies for which the Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one or a limited number of sources under the authority of FAR 6.302. The approved sources are Boeing (CAGE 8V613) p/n 7-511315451-001 and Pall Aeropower Corp. (CAGE 18350) p/n ACC574F83. Interested persons may identify their interest and capability to respond to the requirement or submit proposals. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals. A determination by the Government not to compete with this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will normally be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. Based upon market research, the Government is not using the policies contained in Part 12, Acquisition of Commercial Items, in its solicitation for the described supplies.
